contextInstructions: DevKit skills focus on software development workflows: /devkit:review, /devkit:review-pr, /devkit:review-pr-interactive, /devkit:review-local, /devkit:review-doc, /devkit:review-codebase, /devkit:pr-fix, /devkit:pr-describe, /devkit:write-doc, /devkit:write-project-docs, /devkit:write-article, /devkit:write-blog, /devkit:write-api-docs, /devkit:write-adr, /devkit:write-runbook, /devkit:write-changelog, /devkit:write-migration-guide, /devkit:write-onboarding, /devkit:write-tech-radar, /devkit:write-markdown, /devkit:research, /devkit:research-quick, /devkit:research-deep, /devkit:diagram, /devkit:diagram-graphviz, /devkit:publish-confluence, /devkit:design-frontend, /devkit:manage-validate, /devkit:manage-skill, /devkit:agent-multi, /devkit:manage-update, /devkit:manage-improve, /devkit:audit-dependency, /devkit:audit-performance, /devkit:audit-security, /devkit:agent-team.

Skill routing: `review-*` skills leave comments or review artifacts without updating the source. `write-*` skills draft or directly revise professional documents. PR review → /devkit:review-pr. Interactive PR review → /devkit:review-pr-interactive. Local changes review → /devkit:review-local. Local or remote document review → /devkit:review-doc. Whole repository audit → /devkit:review-codebase. PR comment fixes → /devkit:pr-fix. General engineering document writing → /devkit:write-doc. Project docs generation or refresh → /devkit:write-project-docs. Diagram creation → /devkit:diagram, preferring Mermaid, Excalidraw, or draw.io over Graphviz.
MCP routing: GitHub PRs and repos → github MCP tools. Bitbucket PRs and repos → bitbucket MCP tools. Confluence pages → atlassian-confluence MCP tools. Google Docs and Drive → google-drive MCP tools.

Child-agent contract: non-trivial skills should use multiple child agents in parallel when the platform supports them. Use specialized agents for code review, repo auditing, documentation review, research, source publishing, consensus synthesis, and frontend/design-system work.

Quality standards: reviews and documents should cover architecture, correctness, security, performance, tests, docs, and code patterns. Write skills should produce professional documents. Prefer official docs, specs, source code, and free/open tools. Markdown is the default source of truth; publish to GitHub, Bitbucket, Confluence, Google Docs, or PDF when requested.
Intermediary artifacts (plans, drafts, research notes) go in .temp/ directory. Plans use checkbox steps for resume capability.
